q2_gaps: Resultative/maintenance secondary predicate ("keep X ADJ") whose matrix clause is a bare-plural generic: the instruction set prescribes the reified result state, the Still tag, the Result link and the plural object's per-member flat rule, but never says whether those halves sit at top level or inside the generic's Implication.
notes: Everything else matches doctrine: bare-plural subject to a 0.9/0.9 distributing rule with no QuantifierPhrase, definite plural object to GroupOf, Theme for keep, and "the Hollows" as a capitalized-plural label taking a Name atom only with no GroupOf and no invented kind. "at the Hollows" is attached to the lantern group rather than to the keeping event; the NP-internal reading is the favoured one, so single-reading is right, but the attachment is the one genuinely contestable choice here.
